runs.t: Factory-installed glazing systems integrated directly into the Infinite Facade® frame — delivering full-height glass, precise tolerances, and high-performance thermal properties without field installation risk.

Traditional glazing installation is one of the most weather-dependent, labor-intensive, and schedule-sensitive phases of envelope construction. Clark Pacific eliminates that risk by installing glass in a controlled factory environment — then delivering fully-glazed panels to site ready to crane into position.
Factory-installed glazing delivers tighter tolerances, consistent quality across every panel, and dramatically faster on-site installation — compressing the overall envelope schedule.
Standard punched window openings within the opaque panel system. The most cost-effective glazing configuration — ideal for projects balancing views with thermal performance.
Clear, low-e, or solar control glass
Window openings aligned to the top of the panel — minimizing horizontal sill joints and increasing interior vision height by approximately 6". More light, less bulk.
Continuous floor-to-ceiling exterior glass — no sealant joint at the floor line. The premium glazing configuration for the most demanding architectural expressions.

All glazing systems integrated into Infinite Facade® are tested and certified to the same rigorous performance standards as the panel system — air infiltration, water resistance, seismic movement, and CA Title 24 energy compliance.
Thermal performance with factory-installed HFO insulation
California Energy Code compliant across all configurations
E283, E331 air and water infiltration tested
501.4 seismic and dynamic water resistance tested
Full-height IF 100 glazing system delivering a floor-to-ceiling glass aesthetic across a landmark mixed-use tower in downtown Los Angeles.
Cal State LA Student Housing East
IF 75 punched window system across 900 student housing units — factory-installed for schedule certainty on a tight academic calendar.
IF 85 configuration providing enhanced vision glass and a refined horizontal rhythm across this San Diego mixed-use development.
Our facade specialists can advise on the right Infinite Facade® configuration and glazing type to meet your aesthetic, energy, and schedule goals.
Clark Pacific is a leading manufacturer of prefabricated building systems. We are transforming design and construction by delivering high-quality, cost-effective buildings with less risk.
